Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
Zelf the Worox <andb...@prairie.NoDak.edu> writes:

>I am working on an anti bleed deck thats going to use deflections but I
>noticed that there are two versions(between V:TES and Jyhad). Which one
>is right?????? My group of players want it to be the pool cost but that
>just doesn't make sense.

The Jyhad version is mis-printed. Both versions require the vampire to
pay a blood. The Jyhad version has had errata since the first errata
was published, back in 1994.

Messages.Author: Mike Kelly
Messages.Body: Deflection costs vampire blood and always has. The Jyhad version was errataed.

Messages.Author: Shane Travis
Messages.Body:
Zelf the Worox (andb...@prairie.NoDak.edu) wrote:
: I am working on an anti bleed deck thats going to use deflections but I

: noticed that there are two versions(between V:TES and Jyhad). Which one
: is right?????? My group of players want it to be the pool cost but that
: just doesn't make sense.

The card was errata'd from day one to cost blood from the minion and not
pool from the controlling Methuselah. Notice that the blood symbol is in
the correct place: it is merely the wrong colour.
